subject: Admin activity export & proof-of-export for SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: security@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity extract request for SOC 2 review

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this — our Q3 SOC 2 audit team needs a defensible export of administrative activity for the last 90 days for the Redwood tenant used by NovaMed (tenant id attached in form). Specifically they asked for:

- All admin console events (create/delete users, role/permission changes)
- API key lifecycle events (create, revoke, rotate)
- Deployment & model publish events (who/when/what version)
- Privilege elevation & SSO/auth events (login failures, token issuance)
- Instance lifecycle events (start/stop/scale) and operator commands
- Any manual overrides or emergency escalations

We need: the schema/field list, export format options, retention policy for those events, and an attested manifest/hash (to show integrity) plus delivery method (S3 with KMS, secure SCP, etc.).

Attached an SOC2 request PDF from our auditors that lists the evidence checklist. Can you confirm if Redwood can produce a snapshot covering 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-30 with minute-level timestamps, and estimate turnaround?

Elena
Compliance Manager
NovaMed Therapeutics

Attachment: SOC2_request_form.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com>
Cc: security@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Admin activity extract request for SOC 2 review

Elena —

Appreciate the clear checklist and the dates. Short answer: yes, we can produce a cryptographically-signed snapshot of admin activity covering the window you requested. Below is a concise summary of what we log and the delivery options we can offer immediately. If you want an expanded data dictionary I can attach that as well.

What we capture (high-level):
- Identity events: SSO auth successes/failures, session creation, token issuance/expiry (including refresh token events)
- User & role administration: create/update/delete user records, role assignments, permission changes, group membership changes
- API credentials lifecycle: key creation, rotation, revocation, scope changes, and issuance metadata (operator id, request id)
- Platform admin actions: model deploy/publish, rollback, config changes (serving config, autoscale policy updates), instance lifecycle events (start/stop/reboot/terminate)
- Operator/console commands: manual runs, emergency overrides, developer/ops-runbook-triggered tasks (with operator id)
- System-level artefacts: scheduled job executions (backup, snapshot), KV cache evictions and cache-warm events (only operational metadata, not payload)

Default retention & options:
- Default (hosted): 365 days for admin activity.
- Enterprise add-on: configurable retention up to 7 years (contracting required).
- Short-term on-demand snapshot (any window up to 90 days): we can produce a point-in-time extract with minute-resolution timestamps within 48–72 hours.

Export formats & delivery:
- JSONL (newline-delimited JSON), gz compressed (recommended for small-to-medium pulls)
- Parquet (columnar) for large-scale analytics pipelines
- Signed manifest: SHA256 of each file + overall manifest signed with our HMAC/SIG-key; we can provide the public verification key or sign with a customer-provided key under an enterprise contract
- Delivery: S3 (KMS-encrypted, put directly into your bucket via role-assume), pre-signed S3 URLs for download, or encrypted SCP transfer to an address you provide

Next steps I need from you to proceed:
1) Confirm exact tenant id(s) and the preferred time window (you listed 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-30 — confirming is helpful)
2) Preferred delivery method (S3 to your bucket with KMS is fastest)
3) Whether you need HMAC signed manifest with our public key or want to supply a verification key

I'm looping in Karthik from Infra to confirm turnaround and any technical caveats.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment (sample): admin_activity_sample.jsonl.gz
Attachment: export_instructions_v2.pdf

Karthik / Rishi —

Customer (NovaMed) needs a 90-day on-demand snapshot (2026-06-01 -> 2026-08-30) with minute-level timestamps, HMAC-signed manifest, and delivery to their S3 (KMS). Can we confirm:

Thanks,
Laura

On Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 08:12 AM Elena Torres <elena.torres@novamed.com> wrote: (see above)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Admin activity extract request for SOC 2 review

Laura —

Confirmed, we can produce the requested snapshot. Notes below for you to share with the customer: 

Turnaround & scope:
- ETA: typical 48 hours for a single-tenant 90-day window at minute-resolution (will scale to 72 hours if indexing or cold storage retrieval required)
- Scope: all admin metadata listed in your summary; explicitly excludes any request/response payloads or model inference content (PII-sensitive payloads are not included)

Formats & delivery:
- Primary delivery format: JSONL.gz (newline JSON), includes top-level fields: event_id, timestamp_iso, event_type, actor_id, actor_type (user, service), target_resource, tenant_id, request_id, metadata (flat map of short keys), and checksum
- Optional: Parquet bundle if they prefer analytics-ready files (we partition by day)
- Delivery mechanisms: cross-account S3 put (preferred) using an IAM role you provide, or we can upload to an enterprise vault and provide pre-signed encrypted URLs. All uploads are to KMS-encrypted buckets; we can rotate envelope keys per-customer on request

Manifest & attestation:
- We will produce per-file SHA256 and an overall manifest file. The manifest is signed with our standard export signing key (RSA-2048 signature). We can also HMAC-sign manifest using a key material you provide (customer-supplied HMAC) if you want direct verification under your key management policy
- Proof-of-export: manifest includes file size, sha256, file path, extract_time, and an export_run_id. We can provide a signed timestamp (RFC 3161) for attestation on request

Retention & custodial options:
- Hosted default: 365 days for admin events.
- On-demand snapshots: we stage the snapshot in our secure staging for up to 14 days for handoff; longer archival of the snapshot requires an approved support policy or enterprise contract
- Long-term archive: we can export to your archive (S3/GCS) for 7+ years if requested via contract addendum

Operational caveats:
- If the tenant's events are predominantly cold (archived to glacier-style tier), expect the 72-hour timeline.
- We will redact any fields flagged by our DLP rules (we do not include model inputs). If NovaMed requires a special redaction profile, we’ll need the profile by EOD prior to extraction to avoid delays

Attachments: export_manifest_template.csv (sample manifest schema)

Laura — feel free to share this directly with Elena and ask for the IAM role ARN for S3 put. I’ll stand by for the role & final window.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
